newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala makes third attempt to extradite Serrano.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala makes third attempt to extradite Serrano.

text.p: The government is seeking for the third time to extradite ousted Guatemalan President Jorge Serrano Elias from Panama on charges of defrauding the state of $20 million.

"These are not political crimes; they are common crimes found in the penal code," Raul Ramirez, general secretary for the Solicitor General told Reuters on Thursday. "That is the basis of the new petition."

Serrano was ousted in a 1993 palace coup after seeking unsuccessfully to seize quasi-dictatorial powers. The government of Panama, where Serrano lives in exile, rejected an earlier extradition attempt because Guatemala accused him of political crimes, Ramirez said.

The latest petition before the Guatemalan criminal court seeks an order for Serrano's capture for misusing and misdirecting funds. If approved, the order would be presented to the Panama foreign ministry.
The most recent petition resulted from Solicitor General Asisclo Vallardes' declaration that the earlier failed attempts did not prevent a new petition, Ramirez said.
